text:
Four power banks in these results support 25W magnetic wireless charging. Two have US buy links.

**Buy links available**

- **Baseus PicoGo AM52 (10,000 mAh)** is Qi2.2 certified, with 25W wireless, 45W USB-C output and 30W input. It costs $59.99 at Baseus, or $53.99 with code AM52 according to Dealectric's last cart test on 2026-10-24. [Buy it here](https://dealectric.com/go/baseus-picogo-am52-qi2-2-10000mah-45w) (affiliate link, so Dealectric is paid if you buy). At launch it was $79.99 on Amazon US, per [Notebookcheck](https://www.notebookcheck.net/Baseus-launches-new-Qi2-2-25W-certified-10-000-mAh-power-bank-with-slim-design.1223437.0.html).
- **Anker MagGo 2 Pro (10,000 mAh)** has Qi2.2 25W wireless, an active-cooling fan, a smart display, a built-in stand and 45W USB-C in and out. It's $109.99, but it's a pre-order shipping Oct. 21 to Nov. 9, 2026. [Anker US](https://www.anker.com/products/a110r-qi2-maggo-2-pro-magnetic-power-bank?Sort_by=Recommended&collections_anker-earth-day-sale-2026=&variant=46550444277910)

**Announced, but I have no specific buy page**

- **UGREEN MagFlow Magnetic Power Bank** was announced as the first WPC Qi2.2-certified power bank, with 25W wireless. It was scheduled to launch in Q3 2025 on UGREEN's site and Amazon, but I don't have a current price or product page. [Press release](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/ugreen-pioneers-next-gen-wireless-charging-with-magflow-25w-the-worlds-first-qi-2-2-certified-power-bank-302505385.html)
- **ESR MagSlim Power Bank (10,000 mAh)** is 13.8 mm thick, with 25W wireless optimized for the iPhone 17 series. ESR calls it "Qi2 25W" and the release doesn't say "Qi2.2", so check the listing before buying. It's sold on Amazon and ESR's site. [Press release](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/esr-expands-its-qi2-25w-wireless-charging-lineup-advancing-everyday-charging-at-ces-2026-302653572.html)

CIO's SMARTCOBY Ex05 Wireless2.2 Pro also does Qi2.2 25W, but it was launched in Japan (Amazon.co.jp, ¥8,980), so it isn't a practical US option. [Press release](https://prtimes.jp/main/html/rd/p/000000665.000043212.html)

**Phone compatibility:** Dealectric says the AM52's 25W speed needs an iPhone 16 or later (not the 16e) on iOS 26, and older iPhones get 15W. Anker lists its MagGo 2 Pro as compatible with iPhone 13 to 17 except the 16e. The Notebookcheck article also lists the Google Pixel 10 Pro XL as able to reach 25W on the AM52.

If you want it now at the lowest price, the Baseus AM52 is the best fit from these results. If you'd rather have active cooling and don't mind waiting, the Anker costs about $50 more.
